use_cases: Hero section background for landing pages creating immersive 3D visual impact
Loading or transition animation with glass-morphism aesthetic
Interactive showcase backdrop for creative portfolios and agencies
Decorative visual effect for tech product launches and announcements
ai_summary: A 3D liquid glass tunnel animation featuring transparent glass boxes and circles with blur effects, wave distortion SVG filters, and staggered CSS animations. The component creates a sophisticated glass-morphism effect with gradient overlays on a dark background, using perspective transforms and CSS custom properties for animation control. Designed as a standalone visual component suitable for hero sections, backgrounds, or decorative purposes in modern web applications.
